findings.finding: Key: From sum equality after transfer: (A+a)-(B+b)=10 ⇒ B+b=10, A+a=20. Let a=20−A, b=10−B. Product equality after transfer gives A(15−A)=B(15−B) ⇒ B=A or B=15−A. B=A fails in A(20−A)=4B(10−B). Use B=15−A → substitute → A(20−A)=4(15−A)(A−5) → simplifies to (A−10)²=0 ⇒ A=10, B=5. Ages product = 50.

Key: From Bob’s transfer: a+A=2(b+B), a+A=b+B+10 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. So a+A=20, b+B=10. Let A=20−a, B=10−b. Use product equations: a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(15−a)=b(15−b).
